tests.name: Ping
tests.description: Lightweight liveness probe. Returns pong, app name, instance id, and timestamp. Use for load-balancer health checks.

tests.name: Health Summary
tests.description: Basic application health: status, environment, active profiles, uptime, and instance metadata.

tests.name: Detailed Health
tests.description: Extended health including MySQL primary/replica, Redis cache, JVM memory, and system info.

tests.name: Database Health
tests.description: Checks primary MySQL connectivity, version, and response time.

tests.name: Read Replica Health
tests.description: Probes read-replica datasource when configured; returns DISABLED if not set up.

tests.name: Memory Health
tests.description: Heap usage, non-heap usage, and memory status (HEALTHY / WARNING / CRITICAL).

tests.name: Environment Info
tests.description: Runtime environment details: profiles, Java version, OS, timezone, debug flag.

tests.name: Platform Status
tests.description: Reports Kafka, Caffeine L1 cache, Redis GEO, stock reservation, and notification channel status.

tests.name: Serviceability Check
tests.description: Checks delivery zone coverage and estimated fee for restaurant + coordinates.

tests.name: Login — Invalid Password
tests.description: Negative test: wrong password should return 401 Unauthorized.

tests.name: Login — Nonexistent Email (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: login with an unregistered email must return 401, not 500.

tests.name: Login — Missing Fields (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: missing email/password must return 400.

tests.name: Protected Endpoint — No Token (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: accessing a protected endpoint without any token must return 401/403, not 500.

tests.name: Protected Endpoint — Invalid Token (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: a garbage bearer token must be rejected with 401/403.

tests.name: Public Endpoint — Invalid Token Ignored (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: an invalid token on a public endpoint must still return 200 (auth is optional there).

tests.name: Refresh Token
tests.description: Issues a new access token using the refresh token (not the access token).

tests.name: Verify Email
tests.description: Marks the customer email as verified (dev/test flow).

tests.name: Forgot Password
tests.description: Triggers password-reset email flow for the given address.

tests.name: List Active Cuisines
tests.description: Returns all active cuisine types for restaurant filtering.

tests.name: Get Cuisine by ID
tests.description: Fetches a single cuisine record. Uses cuisine id 1 if present in seed data.

tests.name: Get Cuisine — Nonexistent ID (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: requesting a cuisine that does not exist must return 404, never 500.

tests.name: Get Cuisine — Invalid ID Format (edge)
tests.description: Edge case: a non-numeric path variable must be rejected with 400, not 500.

tests.name: Get Profile
tests.description: Returns the logged-in customer's profile, addresses, wallet, and order count.

tests.name: Update Profile
tests.description: Updates customer name, phone, or profile image URL (partial update via query params).

tests.name: Get Wallet Balance
tests.description: Returns the customer's current wallet balance in INR.

tests.name: Add Money to Wallet
tests.description: Direct wallet credit (simulated top-up without payment gateway).

tests.name: Get Loyalty Points
tests.description: Returns accumulated loyalty points for the customer.

tests.name: Register Device Token
tests.description: Registers an FCM/APNs device token for push notifications.

tests.name: Add Delivery Address
tests.description: Adds a new delivery address for the customer.

tests.name: List Addresses
tests.description: Lists all saved delivery addresses.

tests.name: Set Default Address
tests.description: Marks the given address as the default delivery location.

tests.name: Get Referral Info
tests.description: Returns the customer's referral code and referral stats.

tests.name: Generate Referral Code
tests.description: Generates (and persists) a unique referral code for the current user; returns the existing code if already assigned.

tests.name: Validate Referral Code
tests.description: Checks whether the customer's own referral code is recognized and belongs to an active customer.

tests.name: Validate Unknown Referral Code
tests.description: Unknown referral codes must be rejected as invalid (data=false).

tests.name: Validate Blank Referral Code
tests.description: Blank referral codes are rejected by bean validation with 400.

tests.name: Referral Rewards
tests.description: Returns referral rewards summary (code, referral count, bonus earned) for the current user.

tests.name: Register Customer With Referral Code
tests.description: Registers a brand-new customer using an existing referral code; bonus is deferred until the referred customer's first completed order.

tests.name: Personal Data Export
tests.description: Self-service DPDP/GDPR-style export of the customer's profile, addresses, wallet and order history.

tests.name: Create Anonymous Tracking Token
tests.description: Issues a TTL-bound anonymous tracking token for an order (used for guest delivery tracking).

tests.name: Tracking Token Stream — Invalid Token Rejected
tests.description: Edge case: an anonymous SSE stream request with an invalid/expired tracking token must be rejected with 401.

tests.name: Notification Preferences
tests.description: Get customer notification channel preferences.

tests.name: Update Notification Preferences
tests.description: Update email/SMS/push and order-update opt-in settings.

tests.name: Order Stats
tests.description: Lifetime order counts and spend for the customer.

tests.name: Order Create — Missing Idempotency-Key (edge)
tests.description: Negative: order creation without the Idempotency-Key header must be rejected with 400. Idempotency keys are mandatory so network retries can never create duplicate orders.

tests.name: Order Create — Blank Idempotency-Key (edge)
tests.description: Negative: an empty Idempotency-Key header is equivalent to missing and must be rejected with 400.

tests.name: Batch Create — Missing Idempotency-Key (edge)
tests.description: Negative: batch order creation also requires the Idempotency-Key header; missing it must return 400.

tests.name: Place Order — Invalid Payment Method (edge)
tests.description: Negative: an unsupported payment method must fail with 400 before any money moves (server-side normalization rejects unknown enums).

tests.name: Get Order — Non-numeric ID (edge)
tests.description: Boundary: a non-numeric order id in the path is a type mismatch and must be rejected with 400, not 500.

tests.name: Get Order — Negative ID (edge)
tests.description: Boundary: a negative order id never exists and must yield 404, never 500.

tests.name: Get Order — Out-of-Range ID (edge)

tests.description: Negative: quantity is required (@NotNull); omitting it must be rejected with 400.

tests.name: Reorder — Non-existent Order (edge)
tests.description: Negative: reordering an order id that does not exist must return 404.

tests.name: Login — Null Byte / Control Character (edge)
